mapper.insert: insert into dish (name, category_id, price, image, description, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{image}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update:
update dish set
name = #{name},
category_id = #{categoryId},
price = #{price},
image = #{image},
description = #{description},
status = #{status},
update_time = #{updateTime},
update_user = #{updateUser}
where id = #{id}
mapper.delete:
delete from dish where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select d.id, d.name, d.category_id as categoryId, d.price, d.image, d.description, d.status, d.update_time as updateTime, c.name as categoryName from dish d left join category c on d.category_id = c.id where d.id = #{id}
